messages:
Sophie: Dropping the Nimbus solution brief + asset bundle for a final pass. Need quick OKs from marketing, legal, and partner ops so we can schedule the marketplace publish. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/nimbus-solution-brief (master, FR, DE)

Sophie: Main asks: 1) confirm logo lockups for light/dark tiles 2) approve anonymized SI quote 3) sign-off on FR/DE copy (vendor: LingoWorks)

Mike: Legal looped. Note: partner ok'd the mark but we still need a signed co-marketing addendum before publishing any customer-identifying quote on our site.

Ravi: PM input: partner asked to avoid a tight timeframe in the quote. Suggest changing "3-6 weeks" -> "~4 weeks" and removing job title/company from the quote. I'll prep anonymized copy.

Ana: Design uploaded assets to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/drive-id
Files: Nimbus_mark_light.svg, Nimbus_mark_dark.svg, lockups_v2.pdf, safezone_specs.png, brief_EN_v4.pdf, brief_FR_v4.pdf, brief_DE_v3.pdf
Note: dark tile uses white mark + 24px safe zone. Can bump to 32px if marketing prefers wider breathing room.

Bethany: Brand check: partner confirmed use of stack mark only (explicitly no tagline). Accessibility ask: alt text on marketplace thumbnails -> "Nimbus Systems logo".

DesignBot: Export complete. Generated web thumbnails (300x100) and low-res PNG previews. Uploaded to same Drive folder. Will regenerate after safe zone change.

Mike: Legal: acceptable to publish the brief with anonymized quote now. Addendum still required for quoted customer names or case studies. Also need to include a one-line privacy attribution on the download page per partner legal. Text suggested by partner: "See Nimbus Systems privacy policy for details on shared materials." Partner to supply link.

Ravi: Proposed anonymized quote: "Redwood's Dedicated deployment reduced inference costs by ~45% during integration." Removed title and company. Check tone.

Ana: Tone is good. Localization flags: DE file has an untranslated fragment "edge inference" in paragraph 2; LingoWorks to patch. FR uses neutral register, ok.

Bethany: I'll add privacy attribution copy to the marketplace page once PartnerOps gives the link. Looping PartnerOps now. @PartnerOps can you confirm the privacy URL and whether we need any extra legal boilerplate?

PartnerOps: Confirmed. We'll send the partner privacy URL and a short signed addendum from Nimbus legal. ETA partner sign-off: EOD tomorrow.

DesignBot: Regeneration queued. Will upload new PNGs and updated brief PDFs after Ana updates safe zone and LingoWorks pushes DE fix.

Sophie: Action list:
- Ana: bump safe zone to 32px, fix DE string
- DesignBot: regenerate thumbnails and export package
- Mike: chase signed addendum from partner legal
- Bethany: add privacy attribution to marketplace page once link received
- Ravi: confirm final anonymized quote in the brief

Ravi: Final quote confirmed: "Redwood's Dedicated deployment reduced inference costs by ~45% during integration." No identifying details.

Mike: Legal will fast-track review on receipt of signed addendum. Ok to proceed with asset-only publish (no customer names) if we finish translations and regen assets.

Sophie: Thanks team 106bd Will assemble final publish package (artifacts + copy + addendum). Targeting marketplace queue for Monday morning if we close reviews tomorrow. :rocket:
